text:
Alex: morning — quick async pulse from me
Alex: what I did: updated NOVA pricing slide, chased legal on MCA, demo w/ MacroHealth ✅
Alex: blockers: MacroHealth email from infosec asking for KMS/HSM details + E2E encryption diagram. don’t have a ready doc. cc @Maya for policy notes
Alex: today: draft an infosec one-pager, flag any technical Qs for eng. also prepping QBR deck

Maya: SGTM. I can draft the one-pager but need the exact answers on VPC/private option timelines and supported KMS providers
Maya: also need to know if Dedicated can be SOC2-only or if Private is mandatory for their compliance

Tyler: FYI—for Dedicated we support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) but HSM (PKCS11) is only on Private right now
Tyler: I can pull the config snippets and a small diagram. might take me 2-3 hrs today

Sophia: MacroHealth asked about introspect/audit logs retention — default is 90 days for hosted, Dedicated can be configured up to 1 year, Private depends on infra. I'll add exact env var names and retention endpoints

Alex: awesome. can one of you also confirm whether we support BYOK import flows for Dedicated right now or if it's a roadmap item?

Tyler: BYOK import flow is a partial MVP: keys-in-transit supported, but the import UX in Console is not GA. we can do a manual onboarding for enterprise (eng-assisted) — that's what we offered to MacroHealth initially

Julian: quick sales note — MacroHealth ops want an SLA on latency percentiles for a batch reranking flow. asking whether we can promise p95 < 150ms on dedicated capacity with 2x reserved GPUs

Tyler: latency depends on model/sequence lengths. for a 2k-token rerank with our opt-quant model, p95 on Dedicated with 2 A100s is ~120-140ms in our tests. I can attach benchmark numbers and the test harness commands

Alex: perfect. can you attach the benchmark and a short blurb that sales can drop into the SOW?

SecurityBot: incident-bot: created ticket SEC-2026-449 for MacroHealth KMS/HSM inquiry — assignee: @Sophia. link: https://tickets.redwood/SEC-2026-449 (internal)

Sophia: got it — I'll own the ticket. I'll compile: KMS providers supported, HSM availability, retention options, audit log endpoints, and BYOK caveats. ETA EOD today

Maya: re: pricing negotiation — MacroHealth asked for a 20% discount for a 12mo Dedicated commit. can we get a tech-led justification (eg. capacity-sharing allowances, burst credits) for the commercial team?

Alex: we can offer a burst buffer for the first 3 months + a 10% commit discount. finance needs the cost impact though. @Julian can you run the delta on margins?

Julian: will do. ping me any model/memory targets you expect; I’ll model cost. aim to have numbers by lunchtime PT

Tyler: quick code snippet for the KMS config I’ll drop into Maya’s doc:

```
# example: Dedicated KMS config
kms:
  provider: aws-kms
  key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
  rotate: true
```

Alex: thanks. last thing — any red flags from legal/procurement on contract language? we have a pending clause about data residency for EU customers

Maya: Legal flagged a clause about subprocessor disclosure. we need to confirm list of subprocessors for Dedicated endpoints (infra partners). I'll pull the current list and add to the one-pager

Tyler: note: Dedicated infra partners include: ACMECloud (us-west), FastEdge (eu-central) — I'll send contact references

Alex: great. for next steps: Maya + Sophia to collab on the infosec one-pager, Tyler to provide KMS config + benchmarks, Julian to model pricing impact. I’ll coordinate with MacroHealth and schedule a follow-up demo if needed

Maya: adding checklist: 1) one-pager draft (Maya/Sophia) 2) KMS config + diagram (Tyler) 3) latency benchmark + p95 numbers (Tyler) 4) subprocessors list (Tyler) 5) margin delta (Julian) 6) SOW snippet (Alex)

Sophia: marking SEC-2026-449 as in progress. will comment in ticket with details and attach diagrams when ready :lock:

Alex: thanks team — thumbs up if you’re aligned :thumbsup:

Tyler: :thumbsup:

Maya: :thumbsup:

Julian: :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Sales async standup: MacroHealth enterprise ask. Action items for KMS/HSM details, audit log retention, Dedicated vs Private feature clarifications, latency benchmarks, pricing model impact. Tickets: SEC-2026-449 assigned to Sophia.
